summary: STOIC main111 regression (iter245) — all green. Backend unit lane (/app/backend/tests/unit/test_fixplan_main111.py) 10/10 passed covering corrections N111-1..N111-6. Live HTTP suite (/app/test_reports/main111_live_test.py) 3/3 passed against the preview backend (admin@trading.bot, no TOTP in preview, DB=ai_trading_bot): (1) GET /api/ops/alerts now includes `mutable_kinds` and it equals alerting.EVALUATOR_KINDS exactly (12 kinds: ea_heartbeat_stale, worker_lease_expired, worker_loop_crashloop, worker_loop_stalled, outbox_backlog, outbox_failed, unprotected_positions, reconciliation_stuck, pairing_no_heartbeat, policy_expiring, policy_expired, demo_account_reports_real); every `snoozed_until` / `muted_until` ISO ends with +00:00 (aware). (2) N111-1 naive-datetime probe: inserted an ops_alerts row with native (tz-naive) BSON datetimes for created_at/last_seen_at/notify_muted_until, listed via /api/ops/alerts — endpoint returned 200 (previously 500) and the serialized `snoozed_until` is a +00:00 ISO ~5h ahead; row cleaned up. (3) N111-2 claim-pairing wrong-terminal flow: POST /api/setup/pairing-token → token issued; POST /api/setup/claim-pairing with terminal_login=<account_number+1> → 409 {code:account_mismatch}; pairing_tokens row's `consumed_at` still unset; retry with correct terminal_login → 200, response.bridge_token present AND response.ea_latest_version=='1.62' (derived from EA MQ5 source per N111-6); then `consumed_at` set. Frontend (Playwright, admin@trading.bot): /bot-health AlertsCard (data-testid ops-alerts-card) renders ~50 rows across 5 kinds (worker_lease_expired, soak_checkpoint_due, soak_memory_growth, heartbeat_lost, auto_mode_demotion). Only the mutable kind worker_lease_expired shows ops-alert-mute-worker_lease_expired; soak_checkpoint_due / soak_memory_growth / heartbeat_lost / auto_mode_demotion rows render ACK only — MUTE 24H button is hidden exactly as required by N111-6, directly resolving the iter244 review observation that MUTE on unsupported kinds silently 400'd. Dashboard onboarding card still reads 'Install the STOIC EA (v1.62+)'. No action items for the main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: N111-6 cleanly addresses the iter244 observation: AlertsCard only renders MUTE 24H when kind ∈ data.mutable_kinds, and /api/ops/alerts emits mutable_kinds. Residual (not blocking): the preview DB has ~100 unacked alerts (mostly heartbeat_lost on R9-LIVE, auto_mode_demotion, soak_memory_growth) — pre-existing noise unrelated to main111.

N111-2 defence correctly places the account_mismatch 409 BEFORE find_one_and_update (verified both by unit assertion on source order and by the live probe: consumed_at remained unset after a mismatch). No pending-token leak observed.
